description: The complete client experience at /musafir-cafe: server page, fonts, backdrop + decorative props, sticky-note anatomy, the MusafirWall orchestrator (scroll/drag/virtualization/layout switch), the three-tab write/draw/photo composer, the read modal with report/delete + sound, the floating button + rules mailbox, and the page-scoped CSS covering visuals/a11y/reduced-motion. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, placement constants) and FEAT-002 (the API it calls). Build EXACTLY per design.md with MEDIUM fixes 2 and 4, NIT #8, the sanitize/img/sound notes honored on the client side.
steps: Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/fonts.ts via next/font/google: Caveat (weights 400-700), Kalam (300/400/700), Patrick_Hand (400), Reenie_Beanie (400), each with a page-local --mz-* CSS variable and display:'swap'. Never a Google Fonts <link>/@import (CSP blocks it).

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/page.tsx (server component): metadata, detect the Google provider, wrap in <div className={`musafir-wall-root ${caveat.variable} ${kalam.variable} ${patrickHand.variable} ${reenie.variable}`}>, render MusafirWall. Resolves to /musafir-cafe under app/(site)/.

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/components/WallBackdrop.tsx: layer stack per the z-band table (wood base z0, wire-mesh grid z1, top beam + floor strip z2) as canvas children; sunlight sweep (opacity ≤0.18) and vignette as position:fixed pointer-events:none overlays inside .musafir-wall-root.

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/components/WallProps.tsx: repeating prop clusters at z-index:3 (two mailbox houses — one is the clickable rules trigger, drawer cabinet + pen cup, fairy lights, potted plant, hanging 'Musafir Cafe' sign with warm GENERIC traveler-cafe tagline, scattered pins/washi, chalkboard 'Leave a promise'). All props aria-hidden + pointer-events:none EXCEPT the rules mailbox. Clusters mounted only near the viewport (shared cull).

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/components/StickyNote.tsx: absolutely-positioned
at left/top with --rot and z-index baseZ=min(10+z_index,9010); tabindex=0, role='button', descriptive aria-label; optional pin/tape, adhesive strip, curled corner; paper gradient/texture via mz-color-*, ink via mz-ink-*, font via mz-font-*. MEDIUM fix 2: apply .mz-note--photo (taller box) under EXACTLY the photo_url != null condition so render height equals placement height. Plain for photo/drawing each preceded by `// eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element` with loading='lazy' + meaningful alt. Text is plain

{text}

, never dangerouslySetInnerHTML. `mine` renders a subtle pin marker. Enter/Space/click opens NoteModal; :focus-visible ring survives the lift transform.

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/MusafirWall.tsx ('use client' orchestrator): fetch GET with keyset pagination + infinite scroll toward the far edge; layout via matchMedia('(min-width:1024px)') reading pos_x/pos_y on desktop, pos_x_v/pos_y_v on mobile, NEVER recomputing positions. MEDIUM fix 4: render the desktop canvas at logical H_WALL_HEIGHT=900 scaled to fit the viewport (mirror the mobile 'scale the whole canvas' approach), NOT raw 100vh. Desktop: wheel→horizontal scroll ({passive:false}, shift+wheel passthrough), drag-to-pan (<5px=click, ignore pointerdown on notes/interactive props), custom slim scrollbar + left/right arrow buttons. Mobile: vertical touch scroll. Viewport-rect cull throttled with requestAnimationFrame (overscan one screen) drives which notes AND prop clusters mount. Sort the visible-note array by the (z_index, created_at, _id) comparator ascending before mapping to <StickyNote> so DOM paint order equals placement stacking; key by note id. Skeleton / empty ('The wall is waiting for its first story.') / error (retry) states. Owns composer + modal + sign-in state. On new-note insert: pan into view, slap animation, .mz-note--new timed glow.

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/components/LeaveNoteButton.tsx: fixed bottom-right sticky-note-shaped button (z-index:10000). Signed-out click → SignInPopup (action='leave your note', onSignIn=(p)=>signIn(p,{callbackUrl:'/musafir-cafe'})). Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/components/RulesMailbox.tsx: a real <button> (aria-label='Read the house rules', Enter/Space/click) opening a portaled, focus-trapped, Escape-closable rules popup with warm GENERIC rules copy.

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/components/DrawCanvas.tsx: <canvas> with touch-action:none + Pointer Events (setPointerCapture); tools pen / marker (wider, semi-transparent) / eraser (globalCompositeOperation='destination-out'), undo/redo (stroke-list), clear; 8 inks, 3 sizes; export transparent PNG via canvas.toBlob('image/png') → object URL preview. Keep drag-vs-click/stroke math in pure helpers where practical.

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/components/Composer.tsx: portaled, focus-trapped, Escape-to-close modal with ONE shared `draft` state across Write/Draw/Photo tabs + common fields. WRITE: handwriting textarea + 280 counter + font picker (4 faces) + paper color picker (7). DRAW: embeds DrawCanvas. PHOTO: file input (jpg/png/webp ≤5MB), client resize to ~1200px longest edge via offscreen canvas toBlob('image/webp',0.85) with jpeg fallback, polaroid preview + caption. Common: display name 2–24, 'Stay a mystery' toggle + optional alias, rules 'I agree' tick (persist localStorage 'musafir-rules-agreed', still send agree_rules:true every submit). Live StickyNote preview from draft. Ink swatches from INK_FOR_COLOR[draft.color], reset ink when paper changes. Submit 'Stick it on the wall': upload pending drawing/photo first, POST only Cloudinary drawingUrl/photoUrl (NIT #8 — never *DataUrl previews); on success close+insert+slap+glow; error → toast "The paper slipped. Let's try sticking it again." Reuse ToastProvider/useToast/SignInPopup from ../guestbook/ui.

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/components/NoteModal.tsx (+ a small useMusafirSound hook, inline or local): full note read view (text, full-size drawing/photo, display name, date); portaled, focus-trapped, Escape-to-close; report action → POST report route; owner sees delete → DELETE route with optimistic removal. Sound graceful-degradation: useMusafirSound() gates useSound by useSoundFx().enabled AND a page-level mute; paper-lift.mp3/paper-stick.mp3 do NOT exist yet — if a file is absent, no sound and NO crash. prefers-reduced-motion disables the animation.

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/musafir-cafe.css: ALL rules nested under .musafir-wall-root — font-family maps (mz-font-* → --mz-*, cursive fallback last), --mz-note-w/--mz-note-h bound to the logical constants (photo 210), paper gradients+texture, layered shadows, curled corner, adhesive strip, pins/tape, ink colors, .mz-note--photo taller box, backdrop layers at their z-bands, .is-lifted / :focus-visible, custom scrollbar, .mz-note--new glow, overflow-wrap:anywhere on text. One @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block disabling first-load sweep, fairy-light twinkle, hover/tap lift+rotate, slap bounce, and new-note glow (static highlight) while keeping scroll/drag.
acceptance_criteria: Visiting /musafir-cafe renders the wall backdrop + props + notes; signed-out compose shows SignInPopup; signed-in compose opens the three-tab composer with a live preview.

Desktop uses horizontal wheel/drag/arrow scroll at logical H_WALL_HEIGHT scaled to the viewport; mobile uses vertical touch scroll; the active orientation reads stored coordinates and never recomputes positions.
Only near-viewport notes/props mount (cull); render order matches the (z_index, created_at, _id) comparator; photo notes use the taller box under exactly photo_url != null.

Every plain carries the eslint-disable directive; note text renders as plain

; fonts load via next/font/google (no Google Fonts link/import).
Composer submit uploads then POSTs only Cloudinary URLs; sound degrades gracefully when assets are absent; a single prefers-reduced-motion block disables the decorative motion.
verification: Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint`; both must pass (lint will fail if any plain lacks the eslint-disable directive).
findings:
All FEAT-003 files implemented under app/(site)/musafir-cafe/: fonts.ts, page.tsx, MusafirWall.tsx, components/{WallBackdrop,WallProps,StickyNote,LeaveNoteButton,RulesMailbox,DrawCanvas,Composer,NoteModal}.tsx, a local components/useMusafirSound.ts hook, and musafir-cafe.css. `npm run build` PASSES (exit 0; TypeScript check passed; 34/34 pages; /musafir-cafe is static (○), the four API routes stay dynamic (ƒ)). Targeted eslint over all new musafir-cafe files is CLEAN (exit 0). Repo-wide `npm run lint` remains red ONLY from the same 15 pre-existing errors in untouched files (guestbook/ui.tsx, Navbar.tsx, delight/AnimatedAvatar.tsx, api/guestbook/[id]/like/route.ts, api/admin/guestbook/[id]/route.ts) documented by FEAT-001/002; FEAT-003 adds ZERO new lint errors. No git commit (per policy). Files left in working tree. BUILD CAVEAT: the first build attempt failed with next/font/google 'Failed to fetch from Google Fonts' for EVERY face (including the pre-existing root-layout Caveat/Fraunces/Geist/JetBrains/Noto) — a transient outbound-network failure to fonts.googleapis.com at build time, not a code issue. Connectivity recovered (HTTP 200 to the css2 endpoint) and the immediate re-run compiled cleanly. The required approach (next/font/google self-hosted; CSP-safe) is unchanged. KEY INTEGRATION NOTES: - fonts.ts exports caveat/kalam/patrickHand/reenie (next/font/google, display:'swap', page-local --mz-caveat/--mz-kalam/--mz-patrick/--mz-reenie). page.tsx applies all four .variable classes + .musafir-wall-root and detects Google via process.env.AUTH_GOOGLE_ID/SECRET (auth.ts exports no providerMap). - MusafirWall wraps its inner tree in the guestbook ToastProvider so Composer's useToast works outside the guestbook; it reads useSession for the composer default name and the sign-in gate. - Layout switch via matchMedia('(min-width:1024px)'); desktop reads pos_x/pos_y, mobile pos_x_v/pos_y_v; positions NEVER recomputed. MEDIUM fix 4: desktop canvas rendered at logical H_WALL_HEIGHT=900 scaled to viewport (scale=clientHeight/H_WALL_HEIGHT), mobile scaled to V_WALL_WIDTH=420; a .mz-canvas-logical inner div is CSS-transform scaled, the outer .mz-canvas is sized width*scale/height*scale so scrollbars match. - Desktop: wheel→horizontal ({passive:false}, shift+wheel passthrough), drag-to-pan (<5px=click, ignores pointerdown on .mz-note/button/a), slim scrollbar + left/right arrow buttons (0.8 viewport). Mobile: native vertical scroll. - Viewport-rect cull (rAF-throttled, one-screen overscan) gates BOTH notes and prop clusters; infinite scroll fetches the next keyset page near the far edge. Visible notes sorted by (z_index, created_at, _id) ascending before map, keyed by id. - StickyNote: MEDIUM fix 2 — .mz-note--photo under exactly photo_url!=null (CSS height 210px). tabindex=0/role=button/aria-label; Enter/Space/click→NoteModal; plain

{text}

; every plain (photo/drawing) carries the eslint-disable directive with loading='lazy' + meaningful alt. baseZ=min(10+z_index,9010). mine → subtle marker. :focus-visible ring survives the lift. - Composer: ONE shared draft across Write/Draw/Photo; Write has 280 counter + 4-font picker + 7-paper picker + ink swatches from INK_FOR_COLOR[color] (ink reset when paper changes); Draw embeds DrawCanvas; Photo resizes to ~1200px via offscreen canvas toBlob('image/webp',0.85) with jpeg fallback + polaroid preview + caption. Common: name 2–24, 'Stay a mystery' + alias, rules 'I agree' (persists localStorage 'musafir-rules-agreed', always sends agree_rules:true). Live StickyNote preview. Submit 'Stick it on the wall' uploads pending drawing/photo FIRST then POSTs only Cloudinary URLs (NIT #8); on success close+insert+pan+slap+glow; error → toast "The paper slipped. Let's try sticking it again.". Reuses ToastProvider/useToast/SignInPopup from ../guestbook/ui. - DrawCanvas: Pointer Events + setPointerCapture, touch-action:none; pen/marker(destination-over wide semi-transparent)/eraser(destination-out); 8 inks, 3 sizes; undo/redo over a stroke list; clear; transparent PNG via toBlob('image/png')→object URL. Pure helpers strokeStyleFor/pointerToCanvas. - NoteModal: portaled, focus-trapped, Escape; full read view (text, full-size drawing/photo, name, date); report → POST report route; owner (mine) → DELETE with optimistic removal; plays paper-lift via useMusafirSound on open. - useMusafirSound(pageMuted): gates useSound by useSoundFx().enabled && !pageMuted; missing paper-lift.mp3/paper-stick.mp3 → no sound, no crash (gated + try/catch). MusafirWall has a page-level mute toggle. - RulesMailbox: real
